description: This PHP source file defines the JobCategoryDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides data access methods for handling JobCategory entities, including fetching, saving, and deleting job categories, as well as retrieving their IDs. The class extends a base DAO and utilizes Doctrine ORM query builder methods.

classes.name: JobCategoryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing JobCategory entities in the database.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Fetches a list of JobCategory objects with optional sorting, limiting, and counting.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobCategory entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingJobCategoryIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing JobCategories matching a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Persists a JobCategory entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes JobCategory entities based on provided IDs.
